intro: Deep in the jungle of Stranglethorn Vale, Hemet Nesingwary challenges hunters to step up their game against more dangerous quarry. Following an earlier raptor hunt, he directs adventurers to pursue and bring down ten Lashtail Raptors.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now let's step up the challenge and see if you're up to it. Venture into the jungle and bag yourself 10 of those bloody Lashtail Raptors. Let's see what you've got!

clips.title: Progress
paras: A true hunter sets his focus on his prey. You, my friend, seem more concerned with chit-chatting around the campfire. Now get out there and kill 10 Lashtails before I go and rid the entire bloody jungle of them in one hunt.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Now that's how you get a trophy or two over the ol' hearth! Nice killing, friend!
